item.title: Michael Vaughan demands probe into reports of Pakistan cricketers sidelined from Hundred competition
item.description: LONDON (AFP): Former captain Michael Vaughan urged the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) on Friday to “act fast” on reports that Pakistani players will be overlooked by Indian-owned teams in the domestic Hundred competition. Longstanding political tensions between India and Pakistan have led to the border rivals only playing each other in international cricket […]

item.title: Kabul shakes as 5.8-magnitude earthquake hits eastern Afghanistan
item.description: KABUL(AFP) : A strong earthquake rocked eastern Afghanistan including the capital Kabul on Friday, AFP journalists and residents said. The 5.8-magnitude quake struck a mountainous area around 130 kilometers (80 miles) northeast of Kabul, the United States Geological Survey said. The epicenter was near several remote villages and struck at 5:39 p.m. (1309 GMT), just […]

item.title: 18 killed in road collision in northeastern Egypt
item.description: CAIRO (AP) : A truck and a pickup truck collided on a highway in Egypt late Thursday afternoon, killing 18 people and injuring three others, officials said. item.title: Tunisia lawmaker jailed eight months for criticizing president
item.description: TUNIS (AFP): A Tunisian court has sentenced a lawmaker to eight months in prison for criticizing President Kais Saied following recent floods, local media reported. item.title: Ukraine has liberated 300 sq km in southern counteroffensive: Zelensky to AFP
item.description: KYIV (AFP) : President Volodymyr Zelensky told AFP on Friday that his army has recently liberated swathes of territory in southern Ukraine, even as Washington and Moscow pressure Kyiv to cede other regions to end the war. item.description: COPENHAGEN (Reuters) : Norway is relocating some of the around 60 soldiers it has in the Middle East to Norway as well as to other countries in the region on security grounds, a spokesperson for the Norwegian armed forces ⁠said on Friday. item.title: Germany’s Merz vows to keep out far-right as he warns of a changed world
item.description: STUTTGART, Germany (Reuters): Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed on Friday not to let the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party “ruin” Germany and told his fellow conservatives to prepare for a raw new climate of great-power competition. item.title: KP CM inaugurates flats for govt employees
item.description: F.P. Report PESHAWAR: Chief Minister Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Muhammad Sohail Afridi, has formally inaugurated newly constructed residential flats for government employees. These flats have been built under Phase II at Civil Quarters, Peshawar, and comprise 96 modern and high-quality residential units, each covering 1,000 square feet.
